title: A watcher that never stops
summary: Thread a context through a polling goroutine and unblock the send side too.

turns.user: goleak fails every run now, the Watcher goroutine outlives the test. make it stoppable

assistant.body: Start takes a context and returns on Done. A ticker replaces the Sleep so a cancel lands during the wait instead of after it.

turns.user: what about w.out <- ev, if nobody is reading anymore doesn't it just park there forever

assistant.body: It does, and I left that one alone. The send goes in a select as well, so a cancel drops the event and the goroutine returns.

turns.user: also waiting 5s in tests is painful. default it to 1s

assistant.body: Default only. Production should not poll every second, so pin 5s explicitly in the config file before this ships anywhere.
